notes: End-to-end prompts used to validate the skills. Each runs against a scratch folder (an Android Studio 'Empty Activity' project or an empty dir with a Gradle wrapper + local.properties). Assertions are objectively checkable from the resulting files and Gradle output.

evals.prompt: Set up this empty Android project for me. It's a full native app called Acme Shop, package com.acme.shop, our API is api.acme.com/v1/ (dev: dev.api.acme.com/v1/). Use Retrofit. I want CI too.
evals.expected_output: Multi-module project rendered by scaffold.py in native+retrofit mode with CI, building and testing green.
assertions: .tezca-android.json has mode=native, network=retrofit, basePackage=com.acme.shop
settings.gradle.kts includes :app, :core:common, :core:ui, :core:navigation, :core:testing, :core:network, :core:database, :core:datastore and the tezca-android:features marker
build-logic contains tezca.android.application/library/compose/hilt/room/feature convention plugins
app/build.gradle.kts defines dev and prod flavors with a BASE_URL buildConfigField
no module applies kotlin-kapt
.github/workflows/ci.yml, dev.yml, release.yml exist
./gradlew :app:assembleDevDebug testDevDebugUnitTest testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDevDebug succeeds

evals.prompt: prepare the project, this app will consume our KMP sdk com.deepdecibels:sdk:1.4.0 from https://maven.pkg.github.com/AchsDCerrillo/deepdecibelsKMP, it only exposes use cases (get them with SetupDi.getUseCase<T>()). package com.codetecuhtli.ddlite
evals.expected_output: kmp-sdk mode project with :core:sdk, SDK repo with env credentials, minSdk raised to the SDK's, building green.
assertions: .tezca-android.json has mode=kmp-sdk and sdk.coordinates=com.deepdecibels:sdk:1.4.0
settings.gradle.kts declares the SDK maven repo with GPR_USER/GPR_API_KEY credentials
there is no :core:network, :core:database or :core:datastore module
core/sdk/build.gradle.kts has api(libs.sdk)
android-minSdk in the catalog is >= 29 (the SDK's minSdk)
SdkInitializer calls the SDK bootstrap instead of the placeholder comment
./gradlew :app:assembleDevDebug succeeds

evals.prompt: create the onboarding module, it will have registration, login and then it should hand off to home
evals.expected_output: :feature:onboarding created by new_feature.py and registered; hand-off modelled as a callback.
assertions: feature/onboarding/build.gradle.kts applies libs.plugins.tezca.android.feature
settings.gradle.kts includes :feature:onboarding below the tezca-android:features marker
app/build.gradle.kts has implementation(projects.feature.onboarding)
AppNavDisplay.kt calls onboardingEntries(navigator = navigator
feature/onboarding has res/values/strings.xml and res/values-es/strings.xml
no feature module depends on another feature module
./gradlew :app:assembleDevDebug succeeds

evals.prompt: make-screen login: email + password, POST auth/login {email,password} -> {user_id, access_token, refresh_token}. keep the user logged in, no refresh endpoint. after login go to the orders list
evals.expected_output: Login screen end to end: public API client, session in :core:session with TokenProvider, remote-only repository, LoginUseCase, form ViewModel with events, Route/Screen, strings in values + values-es.
assertions: a :core:session module exists with SessionPreferencesDataSource and a TokenProvider binding
the login API is provided by a Retrofit/HttpClient without the auth interceptor (qualified @PublicApi or equivalent)
a 401 from login is mapped to AppError.Domain(invalid_credentials) and shown with a feature string
LoginViewModel injects use cases only (no repository, no Context, no Dispatchers.*)
LoginScreen uses imePadding and has a @Preview
every new string key exists in values/strings.xml and values-es/strings.xml
./gradlew :app:assembleDevDebug :app:lintDevDebug succeeds

evals.prompt: orders list + detail. GET orders?page= returns {items:[{id,number,status,total_cents,currency,notes,created_at}],page,total_pages}, GET orders/{id}. must work offline and have pull to refresh
evals.expected_output: Offline-first list/detail: Room entity/DAO/database, local+remote data sources, repository with SyncMetadataStore TTL, observe/refresh use cases, list ViewModel with stateIn + events, detail ViewModel via assisted NavKey, screens with PullToRefreshBox.
assertions: OrderDao returns Flow for list reads and has a @Transaction replaceAll
the repository's observe function returns the local Flow and refresh uses SyncMetadataStore.isStale/markSynced
the detail ViewModel uses @HiltViewModel(assistedFactory = ...) with an @Assisted NavKey
the list screen uses PullToRefreshBox and collectAsStateWithLifecycle
feature/orders/schemas/ contains an exported Room schema
./gradlew :app:assembleDevDebug testDebugUnitTest succeeds

evals.prompt: add a payments repository to the payments feature with getPlans and confirmPayment, don't do this offline
evals.expected_output: Remote-only repository (no Room), suspend DataResult functions.
assertions: PaymentsRepositoryImpl has no local data source or DAO dependency
functions are suspend and return DataResult
the repository is bound with @Binds in the feature's Hilt module

evals.prompt: add tests for the order list ViewModel, the orders repository and the orders DAO
evals.expected_output: Fake-based ViewModel and repository tests, Robolectric DAO test, all passing.
assertions: OrderListViewModelTest uses MainDispatcherRule and Turbine
the repository test covers cache hit, stale refresh and refresh failure keeping cached data
the DAO test runs with @RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class) on an in-memory database
./gradlew :feature:orders:testDebugUnitTest succeeds with >= 6 tests

evals.prompt: audit /path/to/old-project before we publish it, I think it has problems
evals.expected_output: Prioritized P0/P1/P2 report with file:line evidence mapped to checklist ids, and an ordered fix plan; no code changed before approval.
assertions: the report has P0, P1 and P2 sections and a 'What's already good' section
every finding cites a checklist id (e.g. [V4]) and a path:line
no files were modified
